$comment: Settings of the core (spec, section 22). Defaults that name tools live here, in data, not in core code.

editor.fontSize.description: Font size of the editor, in points.

files.eol.description: Line endings of new files; existing files keep theirs.

files.exclude.description: Globs hidden from the file tree and searches.

search.ignoreFiles.description: Names of files whose patterns hide files from Quick Open and searches.

files.watcherExclude.description: Globs whose changes are not watched.
